title: Remulla warns of 'micro hubs' in Metro Manila as scam operations evolve
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Authorities are tracking three active micro scam hubs in Metro Manila that are allegedly linked to dismissed police and military officers, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Authorities are tracking three active micro scam hubs in Metro Manila that are allegedly linked to dismissed police and military officers, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said on Wednesday. Remulla cited the Oct. 2 raid on a suspected scam hub in Zamboanga Sibugay, which authorities described as the largest raid on a Philippine offshore gaming operator (Pogo) since the nationwide ban on the industry two years ago. The operation led to the arrest and rescue of 244 foreign nationals, mostly Chinese. “We caught the one in Zamboanga Sibugay. We’re actively tracking three more here in the Metro Manila area,” […]...
